Maria CSM: Quick heads-up — prepping an exec dry-run for ACME (QBR readout) Wed 10:00am PT. Need slide owners, run order, and any renewal flags. I uploaded the deck here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/ACME-QBR
Sam Eng: Thanks — what's the latest on their renewal signal? I saw usage dip last month.
Jordan PM: Onboarding still has two gaps: SSO not enforced, and model tuning patch delayed. I'll add a slide with status and open actions.
Lee AE: Exec ask will be: 1) confirm ARR impact, 2) clear remediation timeline, 3) proposed discount/credits. I think we should call out "at-risk" if we don't show fix plan.
Olivia CS Ops: I can own the onboarding timeline slide. Will include milestones and ETA. Also can capture top 3 support tickets.
Maria CSM: Awesome. Can folks drop ARR/usage numbers here and any screenshots? Need concrete numbers for the readout.

```
30d active seats: 125
avg tokens/day: 1.2M
peak latency errors/week: 3
```

Jordan PM: I'll prep a fallback demo (lower-cost model) and a canary slide showing performance delta. Need a backup slide for execs with mitigation options.
Olivia CS Ops: I'll add the tickets and link JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-123
